1: KEMA is a leading manufacturer of gasoline and diesel engine, generator, water pump, generating and welding machine, high pressure washer. We started making these products in 2001.
Besides certified by ISO9001:2008 international quality management system, we also obtained some other international certificates such as GS, CE.
The company covers an area of 50,000 square meters with 500 staffs and 2 assembling lines.
Chongqing Kema is located in Jiangjin, Chongqing, a mountain city in China.
